Lost in the City

Ana’s first day in Kingsbridge: a bus station, the wrong bus, a phone call and a museum that closes at half past five. Six parts: listen, fill the numbered blanks on each map, ticket and sign, and answer the questions. Use the transcript only at the end.

6 parts About 4 min 21 questions British & American English
1Press play and listen to the whole part. Don’t worry about every word.
2Answer the questions. Use the colored lines on the bar to replay any sentence.
3When you finish, open the Transcript and check what you missed.
